High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. A bright, adorable adult anime face drawn to her own Face line below — her own eye size and shape, nose, mouth and jaw, not one shared default face; delicately drawn eyelids. Fine subtle linework, smooth skin shading and softly blended gradients. Layered flowing hair with carefully drawn strands and delicate highlights. Combine stylized anime facial features with richly rendered dimensional clothing. Use luminous midtones and restrained highlights on clothing and armor, keeping her own colours in soft, clean tints. Her skin has a glossy sheen — smooth, bright specular highlights on her shoulders, collarbones, chest, arms and thighs, a polished lustrous finish over her skin tone, never wet or oily. Apply this style only to the person, preserving the separately specified character design, pose and setting.

2. CHARACTER
Face — her own structure, not the style's default face: compact face; balanced jawline; peach-blossom eyes; lavender eyes; straight medium brows; short nose with upturned tip; fuller lower lip.
Hair: very long dark-green mermaid waves flowing past her waist, with a crisp center part and two narrow temple twists.
Impression (reads even at card size): an elegant, graceful woman in her early twenties with olive skin; a poised, quiet gaze; a fine winged eyeliner.
Identity (chosen details override the automatic look)
body type: pear-shaped and curvaceous — slimmer shoulders over a narrow waist, full rounded hips and thick thighs, a full bust
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.
Proportions: natural adult proportions — about 7 heads tall, her head in proportion to her shoulders and body. Her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.
Body: a normal human body — elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.
Hands: Keep both hands relaxed — a loose fist, an open palm or resting on something. Gloves are full-finger and close-fitting; plates, water, sparks and effects stay off the fingers.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. ARMOR — LIGHT
Costume: one layer of thin, close-fitting hard armor that covers most of her body: a chest plate joined to segmented abdominal plates down to her hips, shoulder pauldrons, upper-arm and forearm plates with gauntlets, hip and thigh plates, knee guards, shin guards and armored boots; the fitted undersuit shows only in narrow gaps at the joints, joints free. The plates stay thin and close to her body, so the outline is slim and readable without slimming her figure. No helmet; at most a slim headband or temple sensor.
Armor: rigid hard-surface mecha armor — solid plates of enamelled metal and ceramic with visible thickness, bevelled edges, layered rims, panel lines, seams, small vents, sensor lights and mechanical joints, casting real shadows onto the undersuit. The plates sit on top of her body as separate machined parts, never printed or painted onto fabric, never a patterned bodysuit.
Silhouette: a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.
Design idea: The rounded cactus body becomes longitudinal convex coat panels with repeated triangular thorn notches along their rigid layered edges.
Colours: yellow, dark green.
Wear: the yellow flower bud becomes a rounded bud-shaped mantle over her shoulders and upper back; the two dark green spikes become pointed edges on her plates.
Exposure: armor and undersuit open by design only at a deep neckline window with cleavage, and a bare midriff; everywhere else fully covered. Plates stay on and symmetrical; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
Composition: Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, no foreground occlusion. Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face.
Pose: Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.
Setting detail: Moonlit desert ruins with pale stone arches and a distant soft oasis glow.
Type effects: One open hand conjuring a fresh green glow amid drifting leaves and pollen sparks. The tips of her hair glow brightly and visibly dissolve into drifting leaves and pollen sparks. A light trail of drifting leaves and pollen sparks streams back from her heels and back armor.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only.
Avoid: second character, creature beside her, text, lettering, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, extra limbs.
